title: characters@1: one script's character table
description: languages/<id>/characters/<script>.jsonl. The first line is the header, naming the language and the script; every later line is one character, in teaching order.

language.description: The language id; must match the folder.

script.description: The script's key, unique across the repo; must match the file name. Apps file the table under it, e.g. window.SCRIPTS.hiragana.

name.description: The script's English name, as a learner sees it.

notes.description: How the table is written and where it comes from, one sentence or line each.

char.description: The character, unique in the file.

info.description: A short hint: what kind of letter it is, or how it behaves.

forms.description: Joined forms, for scripts whose letters change shape by position. A form that doesn't exist is an em dash.

group.description: The section of the table the character is taught in, e.g. "Basic consonants". Characters of a group sit together.
